name: FAQ, question picker
description: A list of questions to choose from on one side and the chosen answer in a panel beside it. On phones the answer shows under its question.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Choose what you want to know and read only that answer, straight from the team at Muddy Paws Daycare in Stockport.

itemFields.name: answer
itemFields.label: Answer
itemFields.default: From 16 weeks, once their second vaccinations are done. Puppies have their own room and shorter play sessions.

default.question: What does a day look like?
default.answer:
Drop-off is from 7.30 am. The dogs play in groups of eight, matched by size and energy, with a field walk at 11 and a quiet hour after lunch.

We send you a photo by 2 pm, and pick-up runs until 6.30 pm.

default.question: Does my dog need a trial day?
default.answer: Yes. Every dog starts with a free half day so we can see how they settle and which group suits them. About one dog in ten needs a second, shorter visit first.

default.question: Which vaccinations do you ask for?
default.answer: Up-to-date boosters and a kennel cough vaccine given at least two weeks before the first day. Bring the record card to the trial day and we keep a copy.

default.question: What does it cost?
default.answer: A full day is £32 and a half day is £20. A ten-day pass is £290 and never expires. A second dog from the same home gets 20% off.

default.question: Can you collect my dog?
default.answer: Our van collects within three miles of the centre for £5 each way. Morning pick-ups run from 7 to 8.30 am.

default.question: What if my dog is unwell?
default.answer: We call you straight away and move them to the quiet room. If it is urgent, we take them to Brook Lane Vets next door and stay until you arrive.
